en: I never had much use for a name. Names are for people who want to be remembered. Me? [Chuckle] My existence is like gravity or time. A concept that you fear, but you cannot escape. I simply... am.
The Troubadour ain’t got nothin’ on me.
Oh, I’m exactly who you think I am.
By the time I’m through with them, the cops won’t be able to identify the body.
Fact of the matter is: I'd do this for free. The Patron's gift is just a bonus.
The elders of New Amsterdam are soft, clinging to archaic titles like they grant them real power.
Can’t wait to see how Manhattan’s changed in one generation.
Let’s get this show on the road, I’m feelin’ peckish.
We all got weaknesses, but mercy ain’t one of mine.
They gonna cry, they gonna beg, they gonna scream.
I don't need the Patron's help.
I had my own plans tonight.
Do I look like I need to be the Patron's errand boy?
Wish I could help, but I have an old friend I need to say hello to.
I came to New York for a reason, and it wasn't to help the Patrons.
I don't work for anybody but myself.
Today, I plan to sit back and just watch the carnage unfold.
They're gonna tear each other apart for whatever scraps the Patrons give 'em... And it's gonna be beautiful to watch.
I don't need the Patrons, the Patrons need me.
Killin's no fun if someone's telling you to do it. You gotta just feel it in the moment, like jazz.
I like your jacket.
Thanks.
Who'd you kill for it?
I bought it.
Huh. Disappointin'.
You afraid of things getting messy, Detective?
I'm not afraid of anything.
Then let's get to work.
You gonna be a team player?
You're just gonna have to wait and find out now, ain't ya?
Drifter... you're a vagrant, right?
I would say vagabond, but there's no need to quibble over definition.
Good. Helping you should count as service hours for my civics class.
You know how to use that sword, boy?
You'll find out when I use it to cut out your tongue.
Try it, and your rich daddy will be payin' for an expensive funeral.
You're a house cat pretendin' to be a lion.
You don't know me.
I've known hundreds of yous.
Yes
You look a little rough around the edges, mate.
Been traveling a long way to get here. Haven't had time to rest up and... get a proper meal.
In that case, you should come over to the scrapyard after the ritual! I'm sure Miss Shelly could help out with dinner.
Thanks for giving me something to look forward to, Bebop.
My pleasure!
Yes
I'll pull 'em in close to you, Drifter!
Well, aren't you a thoughtful little scrap golem?
Yes
How long are you planning on being in New York?
Hmph, countin' the days until I'm gone?
Basically.
Hey, buddy. You're lookin' a little rough, you need help findin' a shelter or somethin'?
I'm looking for blood, not your charity.
Alright, cool; go to hell, and I hope you get shot.
You're an old-ass vampire, right?
That's one way to put it.
So: Do you listen to harpsichord, or some other shitty music?
I'm a jazz man.
Okay, some other shitty music. Got it.
Hey Billy, are you a human with a goat head, or a goat with a human body?
Does it matter?
Flavor-wise, absolutely.
Normally, I'd crack someone in the face for sayin' that, but since we're on the same team, I'll respectfully tell you to go to hell.
I see the Baxter Society is sending their B-team to help me.
I'm not with the Baxter Society anymore.
How could I forget? You're a scary killer now.
Mind your tone.
Stop pretendin' like you're gonna do a damn thing about my tone.
Not today, at least.
Here to torment the Jeffries family?
Everyone needs a hobby.
It's been 3 generations.
Which I'd say is a testament to how satisfying it is.
Quit looking at my cat.
It's a remarkably ugly cat, I can't help it.
Ya know... I got a soft spot for carnie folk.
Yeah?
Yeah. There's somethin' refreshin' about humans being unapologetic for what they are. Normally, there's just so much...
Bullshit?
I was gonna say artifice, but you cut right to the heart of it.
You plannin' on killin' me after the ritual so you can find out what unicorn blood tastes like?
No... I'm plannin' on killin' you after the ritual because I know what unicorn blood tastes like.
Okay, hear me out: What if... I just give ya blood.
Ehh, it's a lot less fun for me.

I get that! But here's the thing: We're hard to come by. If ya kill me, you don't know if you'll ever see a unicorn again! If ya let me live, you can come back whenever you want the novelty. Also, you get the added bonus not havin' half your face burned off.
...You make a compellin' argument.
You ready for what's comin'?
I don't think anyone can be ready for somethin' like this. All I know is that my friend needs me, and I'll do anythin' I can to help him.
Yes
You don't seem to be nervous about workin' with me.
Oh, heavens no.
I've found that to be a rarity.
Isn't it nice when life can surprise you?
Yes
Do your job, or I'm gonna tear through your little hotel.
No sir, you will not.
Excuse me?
I will do my job because I value excellence. But if we fail, you will not set one foot in The Baroness nor will you lay a finger on its guests lest your immortal life meet an ignoble end. Am I clear?
Who the hell are you?..
I'm just the doorman.
Yes
You strike me as a man who loves what he does for a livin'.
As do you.
Hohoho, I definitely derive enjoyment from what I do.
See you got yourself a wedding ring, Professor.
That's right.
What's her name?
Marla.
Pretty name. You love her?
I'd die for her.
No, Professor. Fail today, and she'll die for you.
When I open the black hole, I'll be exposed.
Don't worry about me not capitalizing, Professor. There's few things I like more than helpless victims.
I'll help satiate your hunger drifter.
Mighty kind of you, offering up your students like that. Hehe, 'ppreciate it.
No! Jesus, I'll heal you in combat!
Significantly less entertaining, but still appreciated.
My mentor, she... she likes you.
I see she's a woman of taste.
So, you're the girl that spends time playin' with monsters, huh?
The dead aren't monsters.
What are they then?
Lonely.
Hope you ain't squeamish.
I spend half my free time in graveyards.
Looking at pretty headstones ain't the same thing as watching me rip out someone's throat.
I'll be fine.
We're about to find out, ain't we?
Yes
Did you do it?
Wesley... If I was gonna murder your grandkids, we both know I would've tied you down and made you watch.
I'm going to kill you.
Oh, you certainly gonna try... but it ain't gonna be today. You need me.
Yes
The Patrons have a curious sense of humor now, don't they?
The silent treatment? Really? Don't tell me you're still raw about Oklahoma.
[Sigh] How disappointin'.
Yes
What are the boys and girls of the Baxter Society gonna say about us workin' together?
I wouldn't know. I'm retired.
You sure look like it.
Yes
OSIC finally coming for me?
No, we're using you. If we were coming for you, you'd already be dead.
Yes
Think you can keep up, Haze?
I'm not getting in some schoolyard challenge with you.
All business, heheh... that's fine. I can appreciate directness. I am going to kill more than you though.
Sure you are.
Yes
Smile, Haze. You're gonna like killing people with me.
Being good at something and liking something are two different things.
Life's more fun when you accept who you are, Haze.
Thanks for the advice.
It's true.
Yes
You looking for the Troubadour, eh?
That's right. You got a tip for me?
Yeah, you don't wanna find him.
I'm getting real tired of people telling me that.
Macomb matters a lot to you, but to him it was just a fun time that'll get lost in the ocean of memory... but if you find him, if he knows he got his hooks in you? You gonna be his hobby.
What's that mean?
Oh, I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise, but trust me, Sheriff. For your sake: let it go.
Yes
Tie them down, Holliday, and leave the rest to me.
I don't take orders from you!
You want them dead? Tie them down for me.
Yes
You spell Holliday with one "L" or two?
Two. Why?
Hmph. Particular spellin'.
What's your point?
I know whose gun that is. You gon' be able to make him proud?
We're about to find out.
Yes
You got a gleam in your eye, Infernus. How long has it been since you really cut loose?
Long time.
[Chuckle], you gon' enjoy yourself today.
Yes
Level with me: are you the Troubadour?
While I do have a song in my heart, I'm not.
Is he a friend of yours?
You friends with every bartender in Manhattan?
A lot of 'em.
No. Never met the man, just know him by reputation.
Yes
You scared of fire?
It's... not my favorite.
So yes.
Let's just say I'm... glad you're on my side.
Yes
Well, looky here. The Savior of Spanish Harlem herself.
I don't call myself that.
Legends don't get to choose what they're called.
I'm not a legend.
Yes, you are. You know it, and you're afraid of it. Don't be.
Yes
Nice to meet you. I'm Ivy.
I don't care what your name is, you'll be dead long before you're relevant in my world.
... Nice to meet you too.
Yes
Look at us. The Sower and the Reaper.
I think you may be confusing me with Mina? I don't know how to sew.
"Sow"... like farmin'?
I've never been to a farm.
It's plantin' seeds.
Sure, but I'm not a farmer, so why would you say that?
You save lives, and I take 'em.
I think your analogies need some work.
Yes
What's on your mind, Kelvin?
Just wondering if getting the answers I seek is worth helping you in the process.
Now that is the question, ain't it?
Yes
You're looking a little upset, Kelvin.
I don't want to work with someone like you.
Careful, now. You keep talking like that and you might hurt my feelings. And no one wants that.
Yes
I understand that violence is going to happen in the ritual, but... it's not necessary for you to make them suffer.
I know it's not necessary, I just like to go above and beyond expectations.
Yes
Been a while, friend.
I've never met you before in my life.
I was talking to your arm.
You know Oathkeeper?
Oh, we go back a long ways.
Yes
Oathkeeper asked me to give you a message.
Can't wait to hear it.
"See you soon."
[Laughs] Oh, today is gonna be fun.
Yes
That ward's lookin' like it ain't lastin' much longer, Geist.
I appreciate your concern.
You gotta be scared as hell.
Be quiet.
You should be.
Yes
So. What are you supposed to be? Some kinda... murder hobo?
They call me the Drifter.
Don't know if that has a better mouthfeel, but whatever, Mobo. It's your life.
Yes
Are you that arrogant stevedore everyone's been talkin' about?
Arrogance is a concept made up by people who don't wanna recognize greatness.
Yeah, it's you.
Yes
Heard you like hurtin' people, Lash.
I like proving I'm better than people. If they get hurt, that's on them, not me.
It's a shame we're on the same side. I would love to find out what a smart lady like you tastes like.
Uh, just to be clear: I'm talking about drinking your blood. Nothin' untoward.
I ju- I just didn't want there to be any confusion.
Ready to get your hands dirty?
I was expectin' a little more enthusiasm. [Chuckles]
I have.
Where do you work again? Fairfax and Sons?
If I did, it certainly didn't leave an impression on me.
When I'm Viscount, I'll lift The Venery on you.
Well, that's mighty kind of you miss.
It's not kind, it's practical. You're just gonna ignore it anyway, and it would make me look weak.
You're a smart young lady.
You know who I am, right?
Everyone in the Barony of New York knows who you are.
Then why aren't you bein' a good little vampire and followin' Simon's orders?
Because if you're old enough to call the Viscount by his first name, you're probably strong enough to tear me in half.
Ha, I got a funny story about that. I'll tell you later.
Your coat's awful.
It's sentimental.
Yeah, that doesn't make it any less heinous. After the ritual, I'm getting you something tailored.
I dunno. It's not the same if I don't work for it.
If killing a bunch of people and summoning the Patron isn't working for it, I don't know what is.
Why do you care so much?
Because I want to say I made a bespoke jacket for a legend.
Miss, you've made a compellin' argument.
Yes
So how much dirty work do the Djinn have you do?
Nashala is a woman of nobility and poise. She doesn't ask me to do dirty work.
I see. So she don't trust you.
She trusts me, implicitly.
Of course.
I don't like your tone, vampire.
If you don't like it now, wait 'til you hear the sounds I make when I'm rippin' out your gullet.
You dare threaten an emissary of the Djinn?
Heh heh heh... ritual's starting, pretty boy. We'll finish this later.
Yes
Nashala has warned me about you.
And Nashala don't know me.
She knows your deeds.
If she really did, she woulda told you to play nice.
Yes
What happens if I break that fancy bottle of yours?
I kill you.
You'll try.
No. I'll kill you.
It's nice to work with some fellow predators.
I don't know if I'd call us "predators"...
I mean, one of you holds down a victim while the other beats them to death. Seems pretty damn predatory to me.
I, uh, hm... I suppose it does.
So, how often do you drag people down into the sewers and rip their arms off?
It is a common threat, but not a common occurrence.
You boys need to live a little.
So... Drifter.
Yes?
You prey on humans, right?
Worried I've developed a taste for mole?
The thought has crossed our minds.
Don't worry, boys. I got plenty of people to kill this trip without worryin' about you.
How 'bout you tell me a story, Paige?
Once, there was a girl who was being harassed by a vampire...
Oh, I love it already...
So... she staked him, the end.
I don't take kindly to threats.
What threat? It was just a story, heh!..
Hehe, you're fun... I'll let it slide...
You're not gonna kill me, right?
I ate before I showed up to the ritual.
Sure, but- what about... for fun?
You think it'd be fun?
I'm gonna stop talking.
Smart girl.
You're a monster, but I will protect you.
That's what I love about humanity.
Kindness in the face of evil?
Sure. Let's call it kindness and not you compromisin' your morals cause you wanna win.
Yes
You look annoyed.
I am annoyed. You don't have anything interesting to steal.
Yes
What size jacket do you wear?
Why?
Well, it's a nice coat.
All members of Paradox wear one.
You got any friends who don't mind goin' missing?
I can just get you a coat.
Doesn't work like that.
Yes
Don't worry. If they try to run from you, I'll bring them back into position.
Thank you kindly, miss.
You ever kill someone?
No.
I think you'll get a taste for it.
Somehow I doubt that.
I bet you're gonna surprise yourself.
I can smell blood on your jacket. Whose is it?
Mine.
I guessin' you didn't cut yourself shavin'.
No.
That a Kelsey Evans?
You know your coats.
That I do, my friend.
I bet your dreams are scary.
Not particularly. I sleep like a baby.
You smell like blood.
That's cause I murdered someone before I showed up for the ritual.
Why would you do that?!
A musician's gotta warm up before they perform.
Can I follow you?
You're not gonna whine about morality, are ya?
What's morality?
Hehehe, stick with me, kid! I teach you all sorts of things.
Ya know... I used to be like you.
Somehow, I doubt that.
I used to play the game, wear the lace, say the pretty words. Let me tell you, friend... the pursuit of power is a trap.
Spoken like a man who never attained it.
Sure.
Seven... people paint you as a monster, but underneath all that falderal... you're no Boogeyman. You're just a man.
I am so much more.
No. You're not.
Watch me, Drifter, and see for yourself.
Today, our enemies suffer.
Oh, I'm lookin' forward to seein' you live up to the hype.
I have nothing to prove to you, Drifter!.. but you will be impressed nonetheless.
Been a while.
Don't talk to me.
Wh- You worried your new friends are gonna get mad?
Don't. Talk to me.
Enjoy your indignation. In about 10 seconds, everyone is gonna see who you really are.
What the hell happened to you, Shiv... you used to be a man.
If I'm disappointin' you, I must be doin' somethin' right.
No hug for an old friend?
Be happy there's no knife for an old friend.
That's the Shiv I like to see! Glad to know he's still in there.
Go to hell.
Silver, Silver, Silver... how's my favorite cut-rate bounty hunter?
You're lucky the Patron wants me to play nice.
I'm lucky? Sweetheart, any other day your heart would be out of your body by now.
Well, let's finish the ritual and find out what happens when you don't have a knife-throwing psychopath as backup?
I can't wait.
What are you gettin' outta this?
The satisfaction of a job well done.
I know I'm not Shiv, but I hope you enjoy our time together.
I'm gonna enjoy watching you get hurt.
I dunno what's gonna be better: When I save your life and you owe me, or when you realize you have to save mine in order to win.
God, can you just shut up?!
This is gonna be fun.
After the ritual's complete, I'm going to drive a stake in your heart.
You ain't the first Venator to make that claim, and you sure as hell ain't gonna be the last.
You've never fought a man like me before.
That's where you're wrong, Father. I've killed hundreds of men who think they're the exception to the rule... and let me tell ya: The exceptional and the pathetic bleed out just the same.
Forgive me, Father, for I will sin.
Enjoy your last day of wanton slaughter, Drifter. Tomorrow your wretched life will come to an end.
Hehe, I can't wait.
What would your Vatican masters say if they saw you now...
I'm not interested in your musings, vampire.
Yeah? What about my threats?
Equally pointless.
I'm gonna enjoy takin' my time with you when this is over.
The feeling's mutual.
I don't suppose you killed any part of me?
I'm gonna be honest, it all kind of blends together.
Figured as much.
Yeah, sorry 'bout dat.
It's fine. I get it.
You know, you puttin' too high a premium on your past.
I need to know where I came from.
No, you don't. You need to know where you are. The past is a trap, the future is a fantasy. Just be, Victor. You'll be happier.
You got a plan, Victor?
Make them suffer like I suffer.
That's the spirit, friend.
Yes
Why limit yourself to the Friends of Humanity when there's plenty of people that deserve to die?
You have to start somewhere.
Now that's some ambition I can appreciate!
Yes
What's with the rifle? Don't like working up close?
I'm not psychotic enough to have a preference.
I thought I was gonna like you.
Yes
Just to get this out of the way, I'm not precious about murder. If I'm carving someone up and you wanna take the shot, I'm not gonna be offended.
How magnanimous of you.
We're a team, right?
I hear you drink people's blood.
They ain't lying.
I bet that makes it hard to make friends.
Doesn' help.
I don't have blood, so we can be friends!
[sighs] Great.
Before the ritual, I heard you tell someone that you wanted to see what their insides look like.
Yeah, I do suppose I tell people that a lot.
My insides are green!
I bet if you spent more time in The Cube, you'd spend less time murdering people.
Then keep me far away from The Cube.
No, you'll like it. Everyone likes The Cube!
Yes
Oh, I can't believe I'm gonna get to murder people with you!
I don't know if the rest of our team shares your exuberance.

Yeah, it's because they never did time in OKC- Buddy, you're a legend there! You're like the... you're like the... the Boogeyman! Heh, as far as I'm concerned, this is like sitting next to Mozart on the piano bench while he plays Canon in D.
Pretty sure that was Pachelbel.
Yeah, him too, point still stands.
Yes
Whatcha doin' after the ritual?
What, you lookin' to get drinks?
Y'know, I was lookin' to get as, uh, far away from you as possible while you were still in a good mood, but if you're buyin', I'm good for, like, a cocktail or two.
Listen, I just need to get this out of the way, okay: I know we'd make a good power couple, but I don't think I'm cut out to be with a vampire, like, long term.
That's, uh... that's good to know...
I just wan- I wanted to let you down easy.
I appreciate the courtesy.
You threatnin' me, friend?
You must really hate the Patrons if you're willin' to work with a guy like me.
Yes
You like to gamble, right Wraith?

I know where you're going with this. Here's the problem with gambling on body counts with you: You're a psychotic killing machine, which means if I incentivize you to kill more on top of that, there's a non-zero chance that you don't finish the ritual because you want to pad your numbers.
You... really thought this through.
I really wanted to make it work.
Hm, thanks for considerin' it.
Yes
Between the two of us, they don't have a chance in hell at escaping.
Oh, it's gonna be a massacre.
Yes
Glad you're on our side, Drifter.
You should be, Wraith, otherwise I-
No need to threaten me, I'm already scared of you.
Heh. Very good.
Are there other American Vampires like you?
I like to think of myself as one of a kind.
Are you competent?
At killin'?
Yes.
Hoho, yeah.
Good.
You know, I've... never been to Japan.
Rend's ready.
Rend's almost ready.
Rend's on cooldown.
I can't wait to rip their lungs out.
I love workin' with my hands.
Ready to get up close and personal.
The best part of working close is you get to hear every beautiful sound.
My hands are twitchin' in anticipation.
I'm gonna tear them apart, and there ain't a damn thing they can do about it.
Lookin' forward to slicin' them open!
Ready to do what I do best.
Sharpening claws.
Hohohoho, I'm ready to play!
Feedin' time.
Die!
Die!
Scream for me!
Found my prey!
I hunger.
Not your day, friend.
This is where you die.
I'll take your throat.
Shhhh...
Time to drink up.
I got you.
You're mine.
You're gonna die.
This ain't over.
You got some fight in ya!
Stalker's Mark is ready.
Stalker's Mark is almost ready!
Stalker's Mark's on cooldown.
I'll be behind them in no time.
I'll get the element of surprise.
I'll get the jump on them.
They'll think they're safe, then I'll be right behind 'em.
Once they're marked, there's nothin' they can do, [chuckles].
I won't be deterred from my purpose.
I'll take whatever I want, whenever I want.
Once I set my eyes on someone, there's no shakin' me.
I can't wait to meet the lovely people of New York.
I won't be denied.
I'll rip you in half!
I'll split them open!
Let's see what your insides look like!
Weep!
There's no hope.
[Laughter]
Suffer!
I want their blood!
No one will miss you!
Start prayin'.
Stalker's Mark.
They're marked.
I'm comin' for you.
Look behind you, friend.
I see you.
I got my eye on you.
They're marked.
Just biding my time.
You don't think you're gonna win, do ya?
Hunger's ready.
The Hunger's almost ready.
Hunger's on cooldown!
No one hides from me.
There's no one I can't track.
I'll isolate them.
Let them try to run, it won't help.
I love it when they cower!
If I find someone on their own, God himself couldn't save 'em.
I'll find them, wherever they run to.
I love the thrill of the hunt.
Their blood will betray them.
The hunters be on the prowl tonight!
Track 'em down!
There's nowhere to run!
Follow the trail.
I smell their fear.
Follow the blood!
Oh, I'm gonna find you!
Let's hunt 'em down.
Time to give chase.
Find 'em!
You can't hide from me!
I'll find you!
You can't escape me!
There's no escape!
I won't stop until they're dead.
They can't hide from us!
Here, kitty-kitty...
I'm comin' for you, Wesley.
Wesley? It's time we finish this.
Oathkeeper is calling to me, Geist.
Is the big, bad Sandman trying to hide from me?
Come on, sheriff! You didn't come all the way to New York just to hide from monsters.
Infernus, you didn't think you could try to burn me and I'd just let you go, did you?
Come out and face me, Ivy! Unless you want me to pay the Arroyos a visit.
Lash? Come out and die like a man.
How long you think you can hide from me, child?
Where you run off to, Pocket?
Seven, don't tell me you're scared? I expected so much more from you.
Why you hidin', Shiv? Don't want to say hello to an old friend?
Come out and play, Venator... Don't be scared.
Bet you haven't been scared in a long while, Vindicta.
The Darkness is ready.
Ready to make 'em afraid of the dark.
Ready to make 'em all blind.
Ready to make darkness fall.
Ready to spread terror.
Ready to sow fear.
Ready to spread darkness.
The darkness will spread.
They are not gonna see us comin'!
Ready to stalk 'em!
The Darkness is almost ready!
The Darkness is on cooldown.
They're gonna be lost in the wilderness.
The darkness will come for 'em.
First comes the darkness, then comes the terror.
Darkness is gonna fall.
They're gonna hear me whistle, then they're gonna die.
I bring the night with me.
They won't know where to turn.
The walls are gonna close in on 'em.
They're gonna feel alone and they're gonna feel scared, heheheh...
You gotta let the dread marinate a little.
On the prowl.
[Whistling]
Stalkin' them!
No time to play with my food.
Death walks amongst them!
Their suffering's about to begin.
They can try to fight back, but it won't matter.
I'll kill them all!
Their blood calls to me.
The darkness comes for you.
Lights out.
The hunt begins.
Dead.
Tore 'em up.
[Chuckles]
Too easy.
Love what you do, you'll never work a day in your life.
I could listen to that scream all day.
Oh, that felt good.
This is the best vacation I've ever took!
God, I love visiting New York.
They never had a chance.
Might be time to pull back.
Well, that was satisfying.
Not a bad way to spend the afternoon.
Friendly word of advice: you might wanna stay away from Times Square tonight. I plan on celebrating.
God, I love New York!
Oh, I’m exactly who you think I am.
